title: ERROR in the branch that is taken fails the whole query
query: DEFINE MEASURE Product[Checked Color] = IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( Product[Color] ) = "Red", ERROR ( "red color encountered" ), SELECTEDVALUE ( Product[Color] ) )
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Product[Color], "Measure", [Checked Color] ) ORDER BY Product[Color]

expected.error: the measure raises "red color encountered" for the Red row

source.quote: Fails and raises and error message containing "red color encountered".
source.supports: the page shows this query failing when one of the colors is the tested one

derivation: Red is one of the colors, so for that row the condition is TRUE and ERROR is evaluated. One error fails the query.
